dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. What animals live in Khao Yai?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. ˈwʌt ˈænɪməlz ˈlɪv ɪn ˈkaʊ ˈjaɪ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Many animals. There are elephants, monkeys, snakes and a few tigers.
dialogue.reading: ˈmɛni ˈænɪməlz. ðɛr ər ˈɛləfənts, ˈmʌŋkiz, ˈsneɪks ənd ə ˈfjuː ˈtaɪɡərz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Tigers are dangerous, but they're very shy. You probably won't see one.
dialogue.reading: ˈtaɪɡərz ər ˈdeɪndʒərəs, bʌt ðɛr ˈvɛri ˈʃaɪ. juː ˈprɑːbəbli ˈwoʊnt ˈsiː ˈwʌn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I love elephants. Elephants are so intelligent!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈlʌv ˈɛləfənts. ˈɛləfənts ər ˈsoʊ ɪnˈtɛlɪdʒənt!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, they are. They remember people and places for a long time.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ðeɪ ˈɑːr. ðeɪ rɪˈmɛmbər ˈpiːpəl ənd ˈpleɪsɪz fər ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: They're friendly, but don't give them food. Food from people makes monkeys sick.
dialogue.reading: ðɛr ˈfrɛndli, bʌt ˈdoʊnt ˈɡɪv ðɛm ˈfuːd. ˈfuːd frəm ˈpiːpəl ˈmeɪks ˈmʌŋkiz ˈsɪk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And snakes? I'm afraid of snakes.
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈsneɪks? aɪm əˈfreɪd əv ˈsneɪks.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Don't worry. Snakes are usually afraid of people, too. Just be careful.
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri. ˈsneɪks ər ˈjuːʒuəli əˈfreɪd əv ˈpiːpəl, ˈtuː. dʒʌst bi ˈkɛrfəl.
